content: Talos v1.13 adds streaming LifecycleService.Upgrade replacing MachineService.Upgrade; talosctl upgrade uses it by default and reports real-time progress (--progress auto|plain), supports concurrent multi-node upgrades. Legacy flags --force/--insecure/--preserve/--stage are deprecated, removed in 1.18, and only apply on the legacy API path for older nodes. KNOWN BUG: on GRUB nodes with .machine.install.grubUseUKICmdline=false the new API does not pass .machine.install.extraKernelArgs to the installer; upgrade reports success but the node boots without those args. Workaround: --legacy (until 1.18) or migrate to UKI cmdline.
